ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from inputting values in the 'Account' or 'Related Contact' field for record type: Contact to Account. In addition, it requires both the 'Contact' and 'Related Account (of)' fields to be populated.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In an 'Contact to Account' relationship, the fields 'Contact' and 'Related Account (of)' are REQUIRED. Do NOT select 'Related Contact (of)' or 'Account' as these are not valid for record type: Contact to Account.
